name: Is there a minimum service charge if I accept the estimate?

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum service charge if I accept the estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our free estimate covers the diagnostic visit. If you accept the estimate and proceed with the plumbing repairs or installation, the total cost will reflect the agreed-upon price in your quote. There isn't a separate 'minimum service charge' tacked on if you move forward with the work after receiving our free estimate. The estimate itself outlines the full cost for the proposed services.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you accept the estimate, the cost will be the agreed-upon price, with no additional minimum service charge.
